title: Practice Mystery: The Vanishing Envelope
tagline: A 20-minute warm-up. Nobody dies. Aunt Bev may never recover.

victim.name: Aunt Bev's Envelope
victim.about: A thick gold envelope holding $2,000 for the 'Newlyweds of the Year'. It was supposed to be the highlight of brunch.

intro:
PRACTICE GAME — this warm-up is not the real mystery.

It's Saturday brunch at Aunt Bev's lake house. Aunt Bev has invited all five newlywed couples and, as usual, has planned far too much: a mimosa bar, three kinds of powdered donuts, and a hand-laminated 'Newlywed Quiz'.

The real reason everyone came is sitting in the sunroom on the gift table: a fat gold envelope labelled NEWLYWEDS OF THE YEAR. Inside, Aunt Bev says, is $2,000 for whichever couple 'shows the most love and the least attitude'. She will announce the winner at 11:30 AM.

The sunroom sits past the kitchen at the back of the house. The only way in is through the kitchen. At 10:50 AM Aunt Bev rings a little bell and herds everyone into the living room for the quiz.

The couples are smiling. The couples are also very, very competitive.

event.title: The Empty Envelope
event.text:
At 11:30 AM Aunt Bev clinks a glass, walks into the sunroom to fetch the prize, and comes back holding the gold envelope.

It is empty.

The flap is torn open. There is a faint smudge of white powder on the corner. Aunt Bev's voice goes very quiet, which everyone knows is far worse than yelling: 'Nobody is leaving this house until my two thousand dollars comes back.'

Somebody in this room took it. It happened during brunch, and almost certainly while everyone was supposed to be doing the quiz.
event.prompt: Start talking. Where were you between 10:50 AM and 11:10 AM? Who left the quiz, and why? Who needs $2,000 the most? There's no evidence yet, so go on what people tell you.

howToPlay: Practice run: keep it quick and silly, and focus on learning the buttons.
All times are story time: when things happened that morning, not the real clock. Your Clues tab builds a timeline for you.
Read your card, then talk to each other. Ask questions, compare times.
Innocent players can dodge questions about their secret but must not lie about what they saw.
The guilty player may lie about their own movements.
Check the Clues tab each time the host releases a round.

roles.name: Avery
roles.publicBio: Brought a labelled tupperware for every guest's leftovers.
roles.background: You and Blair are Aunt Bev's favourites, and you would like to keep it that way. You helped Bev set up the quiz this morning.
roles.secret: You saw the quiz answers ahead of time while setting it up. If anyone finds out, you'll look like cheaters.
roles.alibi: From 10:50 AM to 11:10 AM you sat next to Aunt Bev in the living room reading out the questions. Everyone saw you.
knows: At 10:45 AM the gold envelope was sealed and sitting on the gift table. You saw Gray photograph it.
During the quiz, three people left the room at different times: Ellis, Cameron and Harper.
goals: Keep your quiz secret.
Find out exactly when each person left the quiz and came back.

roundInfo.2: Thinking back, Ellis was gone for barely two minutes. Cameron was gone noticeably longer.

roles.name: Blair
roles.publicBio: Has strong opinions about fondant and is not afraid to share them.
roles.background: You think the 'Newlyweds of the Year' contest is a little tacky, but you would still really like to win it.
roles.secret: Last month you told Aunt Bev that Cameron and Drew 'fight like cats'. If Bev repeats it, you'll be in trouble.
roles.alibi: From 10:50 AM to 11:10 AM you were in the living room doing the quiz with Avery.
knows: Cameron complained loudly at 10:40 AM that the contest was 'rigged for the Planners'.
Drew was in the living room for the whole quiz. Drew answered alone for a while and kept looking at the door.
goals: Defend the honour of the Planners.
Find out why Cameron left the quiz.

roundInfo.3: When Cameron came back to the quiz they were wearing Drew's denim jacket, even though they'd been wearing a t-shirt all morning and it's 80 degrees out.

roles.name: Cameron
roles.publicBio: Treats every board game, quiz and brunch as a championship final.
roles.background: You and Drew are sure you should win. You've been married four months and have already won two trivia nights.
roles.secret: Without telling Drew, you put down a non-refundable deposit on a surprise honeymoon upgrade. The final $2,000 is due Monday, and you don't have it.
roles.alibi: Your story: you left the quiz briefly 'to grab more donuts from the kitchen' and came straight back.
knows: The powdered donuts were on the kitchen counter all morning.
Drew's denim jacket was hanging in the hall closet.
goals: Keep everyone's attention on Ellis and Finley, who are famously broke.
Don't let anyone look in Drew's jacket.
roles.killerBrief: PRACTICE: You took the money. At 11:02 AM you left the quiz, saying you were getting donuts. You grabbed Drew's jacket from the hall, walked through the kitchen to the sunroom, tore open the envelope (your fingers had donut sugar on them), stuffed the cash in the jacket pocket, and were back by 11:08 AM. Blame the broke couple. You may lie about where you went, but if someone proves you went past the kitchen counter, admit you 'looked in the sunroom for napkins'.

roles.name: Drew
roles.publicBio: Demands a rematch for everything, including brunch.
roles.background: You love Cameron's competitive streak, mostly. You were fully focused on beating everyone at the quiz.
roles.secret: You've been secretly practicing quiz questions all week with flashcards. It's embarrassing.
roles.alibi: From 10:50 AM to 11:10 AM you were in the living room answering every quiz question. You never left.
knows: Cameron left the quiz at about 11:02 AM and came back at about 11:08 AM.
Your denim jacket was in the hall closet. You didn't wear it today.
goals: Win the quiz, even if you have to do it alone.
Find out why Cameron has been checking their banking app all morning.

roundInfo.2: You notice Cameron is now wearing your denim jacket. You did not lend it to them.

roles.name: Ellis
roles.publicBio: Brought a coupon as a wedding gift and stands by it.
roles.background: You and Finley are on a very tight budget, and $2,000 would change your semester.
roles.secret: You've been quietly sneaking powdered donuts into a napkin in your bag all morning to take home.
roles.alibi: At 10:55 AM you left the quiz to grab napkins from the kitchen and were back by 10:57 AM. Tessa was in the kitchen and saw you.
knows: When you went to the kitchen at 10:55 AM, the door to the sunroom was closed.
Your hands are covered in powdered sugar. It looks bad, you know.
goals: Keep your donut stash secret.
Point out that you were only gone for two minutes.

roles.name: Finley
roles.publicBio: Knows the price of everything in this house and will tell you.
roles.background: You priced Aunt Bev's lake house online on the drive up. It's a lot.
roles.secret: You told Aunt Bev you're 'between jobs'. You were fired from the campus coffee shop for eating the muffins.
roles.alibi: From 10:50 AM to 11:10 AM you were in the living room doing the quiz.
knows: Ellis left at 10:55 AM and was back before the next question, about two minutes.
At 11:04 AM you heard a ripping, paper-tearing sound from the back of the house.
goals: Prove Ellis didn't have time to do it.
Find out who left the quiz around 11:04 AM.

roles.name: Gray
roles.publicBio: Filming 'content' for a brunch vlog nobody asked for.
roles.background: You and Harper post about your marriage online. Brunch at the lake is perfect content.
roles.secret: Your follower count is mostly bots. You bought them.
roles.alibi: From 10:50 AM to 11:10 AM you were in the living room doing the quiz, and filming it.
knows: At 10:45 AM you photographed the gold envelope on the gift table. It was sealed.
During the quiz you could see Harper through the front window, pacing on the front porch on a phone call.
goals: Get everyone to say hi to the vlog.
Prove Harper never went near the back of the house.

roles.name: Harper
roles.publicBio: Always on a call with a 'brand partner'.
roles.background: You handle the business side of your and Gray's online presence.
roles.secret: A sponsor just dropped you. You've been on the phone begging them to come back.
roles.alibi: From 10:50 AM to 11:05 AM you were on a phone call on the front porch. Gray could see you through the window.
knows: The front porch doesn't connect to the sunroom. You'd have to walk through the whole house.
Your call log shows a 15-minute call from 10:50 AM to 11:05 AM.
goals: Keep the dropped sponsor secret.
Get someone else to admit they left the quiz.

roles.name: Jasmine
roles.publicBio: Notices everything and says almost nothing.
roles.background: You and Tessa came mostly for the food and the lake view.
roles.secret: You broke one of Aunt Bev's decorative swans in the sunroom and hid the pieces behind a plant.
roles.alibi: From 10:50 AM to 11:10 AM you were in the living room doing the quiz.
knows: At 10:49 AM you ducked into the sunroom to hide the swan pieces. The gold envelope was still sealed on the gift table.
There was no sugar or donuts anywhere in the sunroom.
goals: Keep the swan secret.
Narrow down exactly when the envelope was still safe.

roles.name: Tessa
roles.publicBio: Volunteered to run the mimosa bar and took it very seriously.
roles.background: You skipped the quiz to make mimosas in the kitchen. You had a perfect view of anyone heading to the sunroom.
roles.secret: You've been drinking the orange juice straight from the jug.
roles.alibi: From 10:50 AM to 11:10 AM you were in the kitchen making mimosas.
knows: At 10:55 AM Ellis came in, grabbed napkins from the counter and went straight back.
At about 11:02 AM Cameron came in wearing a denim jacket, said 'just grabbing donuts', walked right past the donut box and through the door to the sunroom. Cameron came back out at about 11:07 AM.
goals: Keep the juice secret.
Work out why anyone would walk past the donuts to look for donuts.

coupleStories.The Polished Planners: You are Aunt Bev's favourites and you planned this brunch with her. Winning would confirm what everyone already knows.
coupleStories.The Competitive Couple: You compete at everything. You both believe the contest is rigged for the Planners.
coupleStories.The Broke College Couple: Free food is a love language. $2,000 would cover rent for two months.
coupleStories.The Online-Famous Couple: Everything is content. A win would make a great video.
coupleStories.The Quiet Couple: You notice things. Nobody ever suspects the quiet ones.

rounds.title: Round 1 · The gift table
rounds.prompt: Set the window. When was the envelope definitely still there, and who could reach the sunroom?

exhibits.title: Gray's photo, 10:45 AM
exhibits.body: The gold envelope sits sealed on the gift table in the sunroom.

exhibits.title: Aunt Bev's house rules
exhibits.body: The sunroom can only be reached through the kitchen. The quiz ran in the living room from 10:50 AM to 11:10 AM.

exhibits.title: The envelope
exhibits.body: Torn open. A smudge of white powdered sugar on one corner.

rounds.title: Round 2 · The quiz sheet
rounds.prompt: Who was missing from the quiz, and for how long?

exhibits.title: Quiz score sheet
exhibits.body: Ellis and Finley skipped one question (about 10:55 AM–10:57 AM). Questions 6–8 (about 11:02 AM–11:08 AM) for Cameron and Drew are in Drew's handwriting only.

exhibits.title: The donut box
exhibits.body: The powdered donuts were on the kitchen counter all morning, nowhere near the sunroom door.

exhibits.title: Drew's denim jacket
exhibits.body: Aunt Bev finds $2,000 in cash folded in the inside pocket, dusted with powdered sugar.

exhibits.title: Email on a phone left on the counter
exhibits.body: 'Reminder: your final honeymoon upgrade balance of $2,000 is due Monday.' Addressed to Cameron.

solution.summary: Cameron took the money to pay a secret honeymoon upgrade.
solution.motive: Cameron secretly owed $2,000 on a surprise honeymoon upgrade, due Monday.
solution.method: Left the quiz at 11:02 AM 'for donuts', put on Drew's jacket, walked past the donuts into the sunroom, tore open the envelope with sugary fingers, and hid the cash in the jacket pocket.
timeline: 10:49 AM — Jasmine sees it still sealed
10:55 AM–10:57 AM — Ellis gets napkins and never goes past the counter
11:02 AM — Cameron walks past the donuts into the sunroom
11:07 AM — Cameron returns wearing Drew's jacket
proof: Only the kitchen leads to the sunroom (1B), and Tessa saw who went through.
Ellis was gone just two minutes and never went past the counter (Tessa, Finley, 2A).
Harper was on the porch the whole time (Gray, call log).
Cameron walked past the donuts to 'get donuts' (Tessa, 2B) during the 11:04 AM tearing sound (Finley).
The cash was in Drew's jacket, which Cameron was suddenly wearing (Blair, Drew, 3A), and Cameron owed exactly $2,000 (3B).
redHerrings: Ellis had sugar all over their hands from a secret donut stash, but was only gone two minutes.
Harper was missing from the quiz but stayed on the front porch on a sponsor call.
Jasmine was in the sunroom at 10:49 AM, but only to hide a broken swan, and the envelope was still sealed.
solution.reveal: The envelope was safe at 10:49 AM. The only way to it was through Tessa's kitchen. Ellis came for napkins and left. Then Cameron strolled in 'for donuts', walked straight past the donut box, and vanished into the sunroom just as Finley heard paper tearing. Cameron came back wearing Drew's jacket on an 80-degree day, and the cash turned up in its pocket, dusted in sugar. The reason? A secret honeymoon upgrade with $2,000 due Monday. Cameron, Aunt Bev would like a word. Practice over. The real mystery is a lot harder!
